justifications.reason: These files remain temporary architecture-bearing integration surfaces for the SPH/MLS-MPM resident chain, render-field ABI, browser demo mount, and long-running project evidence logs. They are allowed to remain large only while the GPU-resident hot-loop, reaction, and material closure contracts are still being stabilized.
justifications.mitigation: New behavior should move into focused runtime modules, kernels, or tests when practical. Split these files behind existing public APIs as the WebGPU marching-cubes, closure graph, reaction, and material resolver boundaries stabilize.

justifications.reason: These modules currently colocate host-side admission, same-device GPU resource lifetime, ABI validation, and embedded WGSL for one authoritative SPH or Schroeder operation. Keeping each operation together is temporary while the two-level hierarchy and shared spatial-view contracts stabilize, and avoids splitting queue ownership or fail-closed authentication across ambiguous boundaries during Slice 7 release verification.
justifications.mitigation: Move stable shader sources and reusable lifecycle helpers into focused modules during Slice 8 source-family adapter cleanup, preserving the existing unit, native WebGPU, browser, generation-ledger, and performance gates. New unrelated behavior must not be added to these integration modules.

justifications.reason: These are generated Vite bundles or staged service assets copied from sibling repos for browser handoff and GitHub Pages demos.
justifications.mitigation: Regenerate through `npm run build:pages` or `npm run stage:service-assets`; avoid hand-editing generated assets.
